capabilities.objective: Canonical authority, PAUTH operation bounds, work-intent ownership, and durable implementation start fail closed at operation time.
Registry-derived session and activity manifests are deterministic, bounded, fresh, explainable, and validated.
Current authority is mechanically distinguishable from superseded history and stale authority cannot enter active worker paths.
Startup, selection, authorization, implementation, verification, interruption recovery, and failure handling use deterministic observable services.
Supported interactive and headless harnesses receive equivalent authority, context, routes, fallback behavior, and session isolation.
Hard invariants, fresh-worker simulations, concurrency cases, and non-impairment checks provide objective closure evidence.
Branch binding, scoped change preservation, promotion gates, and bounded dispatcher quiescence are recoverable and fail closed.
Traceability, clean install, upgrade, rollback, Agent Red portability, two clean release-candidate passes, defect closure, and owner acceptance are proven without authorizing deployment.
